children: Ally Financial agreed to sell $750 million aggregate principal of 5.525% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2030.
Ally entered an underwriting agreement with BofA, J.P. Morgan, TD and Wells Fargo to underwrite a $750M offering of senior notes.
Notes carry a 5.525% fixed-to-floating coupon and were issued on September 16, 2026 under Ally’s Form S-3 shelf.
Offering governed by customary representations, covenants, indemnities and closing conditions in the underwriting agreement.
Underwriting agreement, executive committee action, note form and legal opinion are filed as exhibits and incorporated into the registration statement.
